notes.title: The DLC "Dawn of Heroes" is officially released today!
notes.content:
The main contents of this update are as follows: (April 16th, 10:00)  

I. Release of the 'Dawn of Heroes DLC'
The DLC will be released in three phases, with this being the first phase. The update includes:  

1. Tongquetai System
   1) Entry: Main City → Tongquetai (next to the Administrative Office).  
   2) The Tongquetai system features two functions: 'Hall of Heroes' and 'Prayer.'  
   3) In the Hall of Heroes, collected officer fragments are integrated to achieve milestones. Upon integration, players can view new officer artwork. Integrated officers are preserved outside the current game session (remaining effective even when starting a new game).  
   4) Officers in the Hall of Heroes form various bonds, each corresponding to a global effect in the Prayer system. Players can choose to activate these effects (with quantity restrictions).  

2. Troop Enhancement  
   1) Entry: Barracks → Enhancement.  
   2) Adds Tier 2 and Tier 3 enhancements for all existing troop types (excluding divine beasts and Xiang Yu's troops). Enhanced troops gain improvements in melee attack, ranged attack, melee defense, ranged defense, and destruction attributes, with stronger inter-troop countering effects.  
   3) Troops can be enhanced when their experience reaches 300, along with consuming a certain amount of money. Eligible troops include Tier 1 (Light Infantry, Light Archers, Light Cavalry), Tier 2 (Sword-Shield Soldiers, Spearmen, Heavy Crossbowmen, Armored Cavalry), and special troops from military tokens, but exclude barbarian troops.  

3. Two New Instances: [Northern Bandit Capital] and [Southern Bandit Capital]
   1) These Instances appear via 'Requests' the month after the player's faction controls ≥10 cities.  
   2) Introduces demonized officers as bosses, each with unique new skills.  
   3) Adds battlefield buffs that remain active throughout the Instance.  
   4) Victory rewards include Hall of Heroes officer fragments and activates special global effects: 'Shock · North' and 'Shock · South.'  
      - Shock · North: 27 northern cities are free from bandit raids for 2 years (24 turns).  
      - Shock · South: 31 southern cities are free from bandit raids for 2 years (24 turns).  

II. Base Game Updates
1. Official Rank System Update
   1) Official ranks now include troop capacity bonuses, increasing the total number of troops a player can command upon appointment.  

III. Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where children could select books as training treasures.  
2. Fixed an issue where equipment enhancement skills failed to activate after equipping books on spirit generals.  
3. Fixed an issue where heroic officer Guo Jia's 'Speed March' skill caused abnormal action points in the next turn if no action was taken in the current turn.  
4. Fixed an issue with incorrect art resources for heroic officer Zhang Fei's horse.

Special Note:
 As the English localization is not fully completed, if this is a concern, we recommend waiting for future versions with improved and updated translations.

notes.title: The Feature DLC Releases on September 5th!
notes.content:
Dear Lords,

Thank you for your patience! 'Three Kingdoms The Last Warlord' is about to welcome a new Feature DLC. It will be available on all platforms for 4 dollars. We plan to release the DLC in three phases, with the first phase scheduled for launch on September 5th. Let's take a closer look at the DLC's detailed content and development plan!

[b]The DLC includes the following features:[/b]

Hero Equipment Enhancement System:
1. Each hero's full set of 4 pieces of equipment can be enhanced together. When all four are enhanced to 1 star, the equipment skill is activated. Enhancing them to 2 stars and 3 stars will further improve the skill effects.
2. Enhancing hero equipment requires consuming special items called "Equipment Enhancement Talismans," a large amount of forging materials, and money.

Dispatch System:
1. A passive task system where you can assign idle heroes to various tasks by unlocking different dispatch missions.
2. Completing these missions rewards you with a large amount of money, food, forging materials, and enhancement talismans.

Children's Advanced Training System:
1. Forge a full set of exclusive equipment for your children who have become heroes (non-historical heroes).
2. The full set of exclusive equipment for children can be enhanced in the equipment enhancement system.
3. You can save trained children's heroes and their exclusive equipment outside the game (with quantity limits), and choose to bring them into a new game when starting over.

Advanced Forging System:
1. Further enhance divine weapons forged in the workshop to improve their attributes, adjust special abilities, and create sets.
2. You can save these enhanced weapons outside the game (with quantity limits), and choose to bring them into a new game when starting over.

[b]This DLC will be updated in three phases:[/b]

Phase One:
Hero Equipment Enhancement System:
  Updates for 12 heroes, including their equipment skills and corresponding equipment enhancements:  
  Han River Zhao Yun, White Horse Guan Yu, Goddess Zhen Ji, Return to Han Wen Ji, Fancheng Guan Yu, Tong Pass Ma Chao, Middle-aged Huang Zhong, Anti-Three Kingdoms Cao Chong, Shiting Jia Kui, Entrust Zhang Zhao, Guanzhong Zhong Yao, and Single Saber Lu Su.
  
Dispatch System:
  Updates for six major regions (Hebei, Central Plains, Jingchu, Bashu, Northwest, Wuyue), with 6 tasks for each region (1 general + 5 exclusive), totaling 36 dispatch tasks.

Phase Two:
Hero Equipment Enhancement System:
  12 new heroes will receive updates for their equipment skills and corresponding equipment enhancements, totaling 24.
  
Dispatch System: 
  4 new tasks for each region (2 general + 2 exclusive), adding up to 24 new dispatch tasks, completing the dispatch system.
  
Children's Advanced Training System:
  1. You can forge exclusive equipment for your children's heroes.  
  2. Trained children's heroes and their exclusive equipment can be saved outside of the game.

Phase Three:
Hero Equipment Enhancement System:
  The final 12 heroes will receive updates for their equipment skills and corresponding equipment enhancements, totaling 36, completing the hero equipment enhancement system.
  
Children's Advanced Training System:
  1. The complete set of exclusive equipment for children's heroes can be enhanced in the equipment enhancement system.  
  2. The children's advanced training system will be fully completed.
  
Advanced Forging System:  
  1. Divine weapons forged in the workshop can be further enhanced.  
  2. Enhanced equipment can be saved outside of the game.  
  3. The advanced forging system will be fully completed.

1. The game will be officially turned on sale at 0:00 on February 5, 2021

New and optimized content of the official version.
1. New port stronghold
1) 40 new ports;
(2) Ports can be attacked, occupied and developed. Also, players can station officers and troops in ports..
2. Adjusted the siege map of waterfront cities. Attacking these cities will enter special maps for water battles.
1) 8 new maps of siege maps for water battles;
2) Adjustment of cities: Jianye, Wu, Lujiang, Jiangxia, Yizhou, Nanhai, Zhu Yazhou, Guangling, Xiapi, Huiji, Yuzhang, Jiangling, Xiangyang, Changsha, Hepu, Jiangzhou
3. Assassin function: When NPC Han Long arrives in the city, he has a chance to undertake the "assassination" task, and players can select an officer to kill (the officer can be the enemy or player's own side).
4. 8 new male character avatars.
FIxed Bugs.
1. Fixed the error of officers' biographies and relationship configuration.
2. Fixed the bug of Sharp Knife and Lamentable Song.

Main Content of DLC: The Age of Turbulence.
1. Seven new Ethnic Minority forces.
◇Different Generals: the real foreign generals in the history of the Three Kingdoms appear one by one;
◇Buildings with Different Styles: Each foreign stronghold has its own unique architectural style;
◇Brand-new Units: Da Zang, Shao Dang, Gao Que, Sheng Le, Pinggang Cavalry, Nanye Infantry;
◇New battlefields: Four field battles with a strong exotic flavour.
◇New Gameplay: Players can be friendly with ethnic minorities in Diplomacy or request foreign troops to attack other hostile forces in Strategy.
◇Infestation of the frontier: If the relationship with the foreign forces is not handled well, they will continue to infest the frontier cities adjacent to them, greatly affecting the development of the cities and even razing them to the ground ......
◇Never Die: Cities of foreign forces cannot be occupied. Their forces will only succumb for a short time, after which they will come back again.
2.Twelve Bandits
◇Historic Officers: In addition to the usual NPC officers, there will be some historical officers in the fortress according to historical facts.
◇Historic offficers can be recruited: If players defeat the thief, there is a chance that the historic officers will surrender.
◇Different types of cottages: northwest, central, and south-central cottages, as well as riverside water cottages.
◇ New battlefields: five bandit battlefields in different regions.
◇Harassment of Cities: Bandits will have a debuff effect on their neighboring cities, which will reduce the city's money and food revenue. In addition, the bandits also have a certain chance to attack the city, if the defenses are not strong, the city will be captured.
◇Never Die: The bandit stronghold cannot be occupied, and will be in "abandoned" state. If it is captured, it has a certain chance to reappear as time goes by.
3.Instance of four beasts
◇Field instances: A new field instance system is introduced on the big map, where players can freely go out to crusade.
◇The Four Spirits of Heaven: The four ancient Chinese divine beasts, the Green Dragon, the White Tiger, the Vermilion Bird and the Xuanwu, will appear in the game in the form of replica BOSS trials.
◇New Battlefields: Four replica battlefields that fit the characteristics of the beasts.
◇Unique skills: each beast has its own unique and powerful skills.
◇Generous rewards: Victory in conquering the beast will result in the acquisition of new exclusive sets of equipment (Lu Bu, Guan Yu, Zhen Ji and Cai Wen Ji).
